test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mangoes are bananas.

No banana is a kiwi.

**Conclusions:**

(I): All bananas are mangoes.

(II): No mango is a kiwi.
solution:
Statements:

Some mangoes are bananas.

No banana is a kiwi.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9915ec13792a91c788188209c9aa7373c5e9fad153008a353700dfbf06c0cb7.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): All bananas are mangoes. - False (Because, Some mangoes are bananas.)

(II): No mango is a kiwi. - False (There is no definite relation between mango and kiwi, it can be possible but it is not definite)

Thus, Neither follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
